proposals.name: POTA/SOTA (Parks/Summits on the Air) Ham Radio Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Radio amateurs who hike up mountains or visit state parks to set up portable antennas. Highly technical, extremely proud of their gear, love tracking contacts (QSOs) and displaying badges/stickers on their portable cases.
product_angles: Highly optimized KDP logbooks designed specifically for SOTA/POTA field operations (weather, rig, antenna type, band, signal reports).
Redbubble rugged-style stickers featuring radio-insider jokes, Q-codes ('73', 'QRP'), and schematics of portable dipoles.
SVG vector pack of vintage radio dials, antenna configurations, and Morse code charts for DIY builders.
proposals.first_test_product: The Ultimate POTA Field Logbook (6x9, pocket-sized, weather-resistant layout design)

proposals.name: French Volunteer Firefighters (Amicales des Sapeurs-Pompiers)
proposals.buyer_persona: Volunteer and professional firefighters in France. Members of the 'Amicale' looking for unique, modern designs for their annual calendars, station t-shirts, and retirement gifts. They have strong pride and highly specific terminology (FPT, VSAV, Sainte-Barbe).
product_angles: Customizable SVG vector templates for local fire station t-shirts and emblems (ready for local printing).
KDP Shift Calendars / Planners optimized for the specific 24/48 French firefighter shift patterns.
Redbubble apparel with minimalist, technical drawings of fire engines and rescue knots (not generic cartoon fire trucks).
proposals.first_test_product: Sapeurs-Pompiers Custom Emblem SVG Kit (Editable vector shields, axes, and vintage helmets)

proposals.name: Gaslands & Post-Apocalyptic Car Combat Wargamers
proposals.buyer_persona: Tabletop gamers who buy cheap Hot Wheels/Matchbox toy cars and modify them with miniature weapons, armor, and engines to play Gaslands. They actively search Cults3D/Thingiverse for cheap accessories to print on domestic SLA/FDM printers.
product_angles: STL parametric models of post-apoc vehicle weapons (mini-guns, flame throwers, ramming grills, armor plates) scaled to 1:64.
KDP Game Campaign Trackers and custom vehicle template sheets.
SVG rust and hazard stripe stencils for airbrushing miniature cars.
proposals.first_test_product: 1:64 Scale Post-Apocalyptic Vehicle Weapons Pack (10 STL files optimized for easy FDM printing)

proposals.name: Arborists & Tree Surgeons (Élagueurs-Grimpeurs)
proposals.buyer_persona: Professional tree climbers. High-risk, high-skill trade with deep pride in physical capability and safety systems. They identify strongly with climbing gear (carabiners, friction hitches, chainsaws) and specific tree species.
product_angles: Redbubble designs illustrating technical rigging knots (e.g., Blake's Hitch, Distel) with clean, blueprint-style aesthetics.
KDP Daily Safety & Equipment Inspection Logbooks tailored strictly for arboricultural operations (chainsaw maintenance, rope logs).
High-quality SVG pack of highly detailed tree silhouettes (Oak, Pine, Birch, Willow) for local landscaping businesses' branding.
proposals.first_test_product: Arborist Daily Safety & Rope Logbook (A5 format, rugged layout)

proposals.name: Solo RPG & Journaling Boardgamers
proposals.buyer_persona: Individuals who play tabletop role-playing games alone. They rely on writing, mapping, and journaling to play. They love aesthetic, immersive stationery, hex-grid layouts, and minimalist prompt cards to guide their stories.
product_angles: KDP Solo RPG Journal with custom dot-grid, hex-grid, and character tracking sections.
Print-and-Play (PnP) PDF oracle cards (system-neutral prompts for world-building) sold on Etsy or hosted as printables.
SVG icons and assets for players to print and make their own custom tokens.
proposals.first_test_product: The Wanderer's Chronicle: Solo RPG Journal (Hex-grid + lined world-building notebook)

proposals.name: Retro Indie Gamedevs (1-Bit & PICO-8 Creators)
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie developers building game jam submissions or retro projects with strict constraints (e.g., Playdate console, PICO-8). They need ready-made, highly-cohesive 1-bit (black and white) tilemaps, UI buttons, and pixel fonts.
product_angles: Gamedev asset packs containing 8x8 or 16x16 1-bit pixel art tiles (sci-fi, fantasy, cyberpunk themes) generated or formatted via Python CLI tools.
KDP Game Design notebooks with pre-rendered 8x8 sprite grid templates and map layout grids.
SVG vector packs of retro-futuristic arcade interface elements.
proposals.first_test_product: 1-Bit Retro UI & Icon Asset Pack (120+ micro-sprites for PICO-8 / Playdate)
